The quarterback complained to the Eagles’ medical staff of calf pain on 8 October, according to ESPN . When she was just 24 years old, she published a personal essay in a small literary magazine about how she became “the number one competitive debater on the continent of Europe” before turning away from the discipline in revulsion at the “pretend celebrity” it afforded her.
